title.en: Financial Market and its Instruments: Concept and functions
title.hi: Financial Market and its Instruments: Concept and functions

definition.en: A financial market is a platform where buyers and sellers participate in the trade of financial assets such as equities, bonds, currencies, and derivatives.
definition.hi: A financial market is a platform where buyers and sellers participate in the trade of financial assets such as equities, bonds, currencies, and derivatives.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding financial markets is essential for GS-3 as it forms the backbone of capital allocation in the Indian economy. It helps aspirants analyze how the RBI and government policies influence liquidity, investment, and economic growth.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding financial markets is essential for GS-3 as it forms the backbone of capital allocation in the Indian economy. It helps aspirants analyze how the RBI and government policies influence liquidity, investment, and economic growth.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the role of financial markets in mobilizing savings into productive investments.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the role of financial markets in mobilizing savings into productive investments.

learningOutcomes.en: Identify the functions of various financial instruments in risk management and price discovery.
learningOutcomes.hi: Identify the functions of various financial instruments in risk management and price discovery.
